full_AB.text: Good evening , Saliva . What's that wonderful aroma from your kitchen ? What are you doing now ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I am cooking now !

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Are you good at cooking ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I have studied its skills recently at a training school . I plan to run a restaurant , so I have to practise cooking !

full_AB.text: It is a good idea . What dish are you cooking now ? !

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I am steaming fish in a pressure cooker . Have you ever tried steamed fish ?

full_AB.text: Yes , I have . But the taste of steamed fish at that restaurant is not delicious . The fish is not well-done and too salty .

full_AB.speaker: B

full_AB.text: I have the same idea as yours .

full_AB.text: It's OK . Please have a taste of it .

full_AB.speaker: A

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Thank you for your praise .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Besides steamed fish , what else are you good at cooking ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I am good at stewing beef with potato , frying chicken , hot and sour soup etc .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: So many dishes . Next Friday week is my birthday . I would like to invite you to cook for my dinner party , OK ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Why not ? It is a good opportunity for me to practise cooking .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Thanks a lot .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: It's my pleasure .
